description: Eight-step trigger sequencer in which every second step takes a random jump to one of the odd steps

params.text: The weight of that jump; the chance of taking it is this weight divided by the total of the four weights leaving that even step

inputs.text: A rising edge moves the sequencer on one step
A rising edge returns the sequencer to step 1 and fires the step 1 trigger at once, though the maker's notes put that trigger on the next clock

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse each time the sequencer arrives at that step

notes: steps 1, 3, 5 and 7 always move on to the step after them, so only the even steps are weighted
with all four weights leaving an even step at zero, that step jumps to step 1, not back to itself as the maker's notes describe
The sequencer moves only on a rising edge at the clock input, so with nothing patched there no trigger is ever fired
